author: C Wayne Bennett
text: Tri-Star Septic was amazing! Chase and his family are extremely knowledgeable, honest, and trustworthy. I highly recommend this company.

author: Bryan Berlin
text: Chase with Tri-Star is best!! Chase is knowledgeable, respectful, and just good man. I’ve used his services twice now and will only use him. It’s hard to find honest and trustworthy people/businesses, Chase with Tri-Star Septic is both! His attitude is impeccable and service is top notch!

author: April Russell
text: We were having with issues with flushing of our toilets since all the rain. We called Tri Star. Everyone was really nice and knowledgeable. They got us in pretty quickly. Chase showed up and ready. He was honest and respectful. He kept me in the loop of what he was going to have to do and the cost before he did it. Which was greatly appreciated instead of being surprised of the cost. We would highly recommend this company.

author: Danielle Wester
text: Chase was very professional and super nice. Prices impressed us! Definitely the best price around. He pumped our septic and unclogged our line. Answered any questions I had and let me watch the whole process. He gave me tips to keep our lines healthy and clear. He was very courteous of our property. Will definitely use again and recommend to anyone!

author: Kevin Hall
text: I called Tri Star Septic to have our septic tank pumped. Chase was able to work around my schedule and the rain to be able to take care of us. Chase showed up early and was very respectful. He knows what he is doing and does a great job when he comes out. Dealing with Chase and Tri Star Septic has been Awesome. By far the best company around. I will never use anyone else as long as they are in business, which should be a Long Time! Thanks again.
